title: Úti célok, letelepedés és beilleszkedés (Destinations, Settlement & Integration)
grammar: Causal & Concessive Postpositions, Identity Correlatives & Narrative Participles in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say where people settle and how they adapt, with letelepedik and alkalmazkodik vmihez.
I can talk about arriving and settling with úti cél, letelepedés, beilleszkedés and alkalmazkodás.
I can say what happens at the same time, with miközben and során.
